title: Yellowed Dense Jamaican Bread Toast
description: A winey, dense, nostalgic Jamaican dish featuring wholegrain bread, yuzu-cure, and low-sodium-friendly ingredients, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, olive oil, salt-free seasoning blend, and grated ginger.
Place the wholegrain bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the yuzu juice mixture evenly onto each bread slice.
Drizzle honey over the bread slices.
If using dark rum, brush it onto the bread slices.
Bake the bread slices in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove the bread slices from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Yellowed Dense Jamaican Bread Toast warm, garnished with additional grated ginger if desired.
